title: Health, Fitness, Beauty & Wellness Business Networking Mixer NYC
description: Connect with health, fitness, beauty, and wellness founders, startups, and professionals to network, collaborate, and grow your business.
long_description:
Connect with health, fitness, beauty, and wellness founders, startups, and professionals to network, collaborate, and grow your business.

About this Event

Step into a room full of innovators, founders, and professionals from across the health, fitness, beauty, and wellness industries. This networking event is designed to bring together individuals building brands, launching startups, investing in the sector, or offering services that support business growth and transformation in the wellness space.
Whether you're launching a skincare line, developing a fitness app, running a wellness clinic, or building a health-tech startup, this event is your opportunity to connect with like-minded professionals, explore partnerships, and share ideas with others who are passionate about helping people feel and live better.
The evening will feature casual yet focused networking, 1-minute elevator pitches, and plenty of opportunities to meet future collaborators, co-founders, clients, or supporters.

What to Expect:1-Minute Elevator Pitches – Founders, startups, and professionals can briefly introduce themselves and what they’re looking for (e.g. clients, partners, investment, services).
High-Quality Networking – Meet people from across the health, wellness, beauty, and fitness space in a relaxed, friendly setting.
Business Development Opportunities – Discover potential partnerships, clients, or new ventures.
Industry Diversity – From wellness coaches and skincare founders to fitness tech developers and product designers—everyone’s welcome.

Who Should Attend

This event is ideal for anyone working in or building a business within the health, fitness, beauty, or wellness industries, whether you're launching something new or already established and looking to grow. It's a curated space for collaboration, business development, and meaningful networking.

Startup Founders & Entrepreneurs – From early-stage concepts to scaling brands in fitness, beauty, wellness, or health-tech.Wellne
